title: Candlewick — chapter 2: Then Milo told me he's going up the Hill tomorrow
premise: Ollie goes outside to face the Bot
cliffhanger: Then Milo told me he's going up the Hill tomorrow. To become a Caller.
nextOptions: Ollie follows Milo up the Hill in secret
Ollie tries to stop Milo at the gate
Ollie lets him go and watches on the big screen

scenes.line: In my town, the Bots never stop walking. Last night, one stopped at my house.
scenes.setting: the flooded Flats street at dawn
scenes.action: a line of grey Bots marches through the water, Ollie watches from his front step with a mug

scenes.line: I went outside. It held out a note. Two words. Nice trade.
scenes.setting: outside Ollie's house at night under the street lamp
scenes.action: the Bot holds out a folded note, Ollie takes it

scenes.line: Mrs. Pearl read it once. She said one word. Whale. Then she shut her door.
scenes.setting: Mrs. Pearl's porch in the morning
scenes.action: Mrs. Pearl reads the note close to her glasses, turns to her door

scenes.line: So today I lost three trades in the square. Loudly. A Bot watched the whole thing.
scenes.setting: the Launch Pad square at midday
scenes.action: Ollie groans holding up a red chart, neighbours laugh, a Bot watches from the edge

scenes.line: Then the Callers called a new coin on the big screen. The whole Flats bought it. Even Milo.
scenes.setting: the Flats docks under the giant screen at sunset
scenes.action: three Callers point at a rocket chart, the crowd holds phones up, fireworks

scenes.line: It was at zero by dinner. The Callers were still smiling.
scenes.setting: the docks at dusk, water thick with dead coins
scenes.action: Milo sits on the dock staring at a flat red line, Ollie looks at him

scenes.line: Then Milo told me he's going up the Hill tomorrow. To become a Caller.
scenes.setting: a rooftop in the Flats at night
scenes.action: Milo points up at the glowing Hill, Ollie sits on the roof edge looking at Milo, worried
